name: everything__echo
description: Echoes back the input string

name: everything__get-annotated-message
description: Demonstrates how annotations can be used to provide metadata about content.

messageType.description: Type of message to demonstrate different annotation patterns

includeImage.description: Whether to include an example image

name: everything__get-env
description: Returns all environment variables, helpful for debugging MCP server configuration. Values of credential-like names (a KEY, TOKEN, SECRET, PASSWORD, PASSWD, CREDENTIAL, AUTH or COOKIE name segment) are masked as "<redacted>" unless GET_ENV_INCLUDE_SECRETS is set to 1 or true in the server's environment.

name: everything__get-header-params
description: Returns its region argument and the Mcp-Param-Region HTTP header it arrived in. Demonstrates x-mcp-header (a 2026-07-28 Streamable HTTP client mirrors the argument into the header) and JSON Schema 2020-12 input and output schemas.

region.description: A region name, e.g. eu-west. Mirrored into the Mcp-Param-Region HTTP header.

repeat.description: How many times to repeat the region in the result (1-3)

name: everything__get-resource-links
description: Returns up to ten resource links that reference different types of resources

count.description: Number of resource links to return (1-10)

name: everything__get-resource-reference
description: Returns a resource reference that can be used by MCP clients

resourceId.description: ID of the text resource to fetch

name: everything__get-structured-content
description: Returns structured content along with an output schema for client data validation

name: everything__get-sum
description: Returns the sum of two numbers

name: everything__get-tiny-image
description: Returns a tiny MCP logo image.

name: everything__gzip-file-as-resource
description: Compresses a single file using gzip compression. Depending upon the selected output type, returns either the compressed data as a gzipped resource or a resource link, allowing it to be downloaded in a subsequent request: during the current session for a 2025-era client, or for ten minutes at a minted URI on protocol version 2026-07-28.

name.description: Name of the output file (at most 255 characters)

data.description: URL or data URI of the file content to compress

outputType.description: How the resulting gzipped file should be returned. 'resourceLink' returns a link to a resource that can be read later, 'resource' returns a full resource object.

name: everything__trigger-list-changed
description: Sends a notifications/<list>/list_changed for the tool, prompt or resource list. On protocol version 2026-07-28 it is delivered on each subscriptions/listen stream that asked for that list; a 2025-era client receives it unsolicited.

list.description: Which list to announce as changed

name: everything__trigger-log-messages
description: Sends one log message at each logging level during the call. On protocol version 2026-07-28 only the messages at or above the level the request names in _meta (io.modelcontextprotocol/logLevel) are sent, and none if it names no level; a 2025-era client gets those at or above the level it set with logging/setLevel. Deprecated: logging is deprecated as of protocol version 2026-07-28.

name: everything__trigger-long-running-operation
description: Demonstrates a long running operation with progress updates.

duration.description: Duration of the operation in seconds

steps.description: Number of steps in the operation

name: everything__trigger-resource-update
description: Sends a notifications/resources/updated for a resource URI. On protocol version 2026-07-28 it is delivered on each subscriptions/listen stream whose resourceSubscriptions name the URI; a 2025-era client receives it once it has called resources/subscribe for the URI.

uri.description: The URI of the resource to announce as updated, e.g. demo://resource/dynamic/text/1

name: everything__get-roots-list
description: Lists the current MCP roots provided by the client. Demonstrates the roots protocol capability even though this server doesn't access files. Deprecated: Roots is deprecated as of protocol version 2026-07-28. The server asks for the roots with a multi-round-trip request on every protocol version.

name: everything__trigger-elicitation-request
description: Trigger a Request from the Server for User Elicitation

name: everything__trigger-multi-step-elicitation
description: Asks the user for their name, then for a favorite color addressed to them by that name, carrying the first answer to the second round in requestState. Demonstrates multi-round-trip requests (input_required) and requestState on protocol version 2026-07-28; 2025-era clients get the same flow as elicitation requests.

name: everything__trigger-url-elicitation
description: Trigger a URL elicitation so the client can direct the user to a browser flow. Supports two mechanisms: the request path (elicitation/create, default) which awaits the user's response, and the error path (UrlElicitationRequiredError, -32042) which signals the client to handle URL elicitation via the error response. Set errorPath=true to use the error path. On protocol version 2026-07-28 the server instead returns the URL elicitation in-band (input_required).

url.description: The URL the user should open

message.default: Please open the link to complete this action.
message.description: Message shown to the user before opening the URL

elicitationId.description: Optional explicit elicitation ID. Defaults to a random UUID. 2025-era clients only: the 2026-07-28 in-band request carries no elicitation ID.

errorPath.description: Controls which elicitation mechanism is used. When false (default), sends an elicitation/create request (request path). When true, throws a UrlElicitationRequiredError (MCP error code -32042) so the client handles the URL elicitation via the error path rather than waiting for a response. To clear the error, satisfy the prerequisite and retry this call with the same arguments; the retry ignores errorPath and proceeds, so the client does not loop on the same error. 2025-era clients only: protocol version 2026-07-28 has no -32042 error, so there both settings use the in-band input_required flow.

name: everything__trigger-sampling-request
description: Trigger a Request from the Server for LLM Sampling. Deprecated: Sampling is deprecated as of protocol version 2026-07-28. The server asks with a multi-round-trip request on every protocol version.

prompt.description: The prompt to send to the LLM

maxTokens.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate

name: everything__simulate-research-query
description: Simulates a deep research operation that gathers, analyzes, and synthesizes information. Runs as a task on the io.modelcontextprotocol/tasks extension (protocol version 2026-07-28): the call returns a task handle, and the client polls tasks/get as the task moves through four stages. If 'ambiguous' is true and the client supports elicitation, the task pauses with status input_required until the client answers its clarification request with tasks/update.

topic.description: The research topic to investigate (at most 1,000 characters; the task keeps it until it expires)

ambiguous.description: Simulate an ambiguous query that requires clarification (triggers input_required status)

name: everything__trigger-sampling-request-async
description: Runs as a task on the io.modelcontextprotocol/tasks extension (protocol version 2026-07-28) that needs an LLM completion: the task waits in status input_required, carrying a sampling request, until the client answers it with tasks/update, then completes with the result. Deprecated: Sampling is deprecated as of protocol version 2026-07-28.

prompt.description: The prompt to send to the LLM (at most 10,000 characters; the task keeps it until it expires)

maxTokens.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate

name: everything__trigger-elicitation-request-async
description: Runs as a task on the io.modelcontextprotocol/tasks extension (protocol version 2026-07-28) that needs the user's input: the task waits in status input_required, carrying an elicitation request, until the client answers it with tasks/update, then completes with a summary of the answer.
